about_the_game: Get ready for your own intergalactic adventure! With the soundtrack of Star Ores Inc., you can not only mine ore in the game, but also make your neighbors think you're preparing for your first space expedition. Whether you're driving, working, or secretly making plans for your own asteroid mine, these tunes are sure to put you in a mining mood!
